title: List state gate's actor/bypass-level/reason in the help payload, with a drift test
action: In registry_payload.json add parameter entries for actor (enum from GATE_ACTOR_VALUES), bypass-level, and reason to BOTH the state.gate command and the gate flow alias, stating the facts from set_gate.rs:645-668 (actor defaults to user; --actor auto requires both --bypass-level and --reason). In tests/registry_contracts.rs add a drift test asserting every flag in set_gate.rs's known-flags list (name, merge, approved, lane, no-lane, owner, actor, bypass-level, reason) appears as a parameter key of both state.gate and gate in the embedded payload.
acceptance: bee state gate --help --json and bee --help --json list actor, bypass-level, reason; drift test fails if a known flag is missing; cargo test green
